summary.en: Average-composition isotope modelling and scalable protein quantification address two computational bottlenecks in mass spectrometry.
summary.zh: 平均组成同位素建模与可扩展蛋白定量，分别面向质谱数据处理中的两类计算需求。

en: Today's selections cover isotope-distribution modelling with modification handling and changes to a protein-quantification package. Evidence comes from publisher metadata, author software documentation and official release notes; quantitative benchmarks and independent replication were not assessed.
zh: 今天关注支持修饰处理的同位素分布建模，以及蛋白定量软件的功能更新。证据来自出版方书目信息、作者软件说明与官方版本记录；未核验定量基准，未开展独立复现。

papers.title: Pointless 2.0: A Fast Compositional Modelling Framework to Predict the Isotope Distribution for Average Biomolecules with a Convolution Operator for Modification Handling

read_scope.en: Publisher metadata and author software documentation; full paper not read and results not reproduced.
read_scope.zh: 阅读官方书目信息与作者软件说明；未读论文全文，未复现。

commentary.zh: OCR变换与低阶回归预测DNA、RNA及肽平均组成的同位素分布，IsoSwap卷积处理硫及化学或翻译后修饰，可由平均质量估计单同位素质量。尚未核验论文定量基准，平均组成不替代已知分子式的精确计算。
commentary.en: Pointless 2.0 uses OCR transformation and low-order regression to predict isotope distributions for average DNA, RNA and peptides, with IsoSwap convolution for sulfur and chemical or post-translational modifications. It can estimate monoisotopic mass from average mass. Quantitative benchmarks were not verified, and average-composition predictions do not replace exact calculations from known formulas.

papers.title: Protein Quantification in Mass Spectrometry-Based Proteomics

publication_status.en: Software revision: iq 2.2.0 (November 6); CRAN currently lists 2.3.0 (November 14), whose changes were not verified.
publication_status.zh: 软件修订：iq 2.2.0（11月6日）；CRAN现为2.3.0（11月14日），其具体变化未核实。

read_scope.en: Official package metadata and NEWS; software not run and results not reproduced. Alex A. Henneman is credited as a contributor.
read_scope.zh: 阅读官方包页和NEWS；未运行软件，未复现。Alex A. Henneman署名角色为contributor。

commentary.zh: iq 2.2.0统一文本、Parquet及data frame入口，支持流式读取和并行分批量化，并将MaxLFQ例程切换到maxlfq_bit，移除Rcpp/RcppEigen依赖。没有新版独立性能评测，不应推断精度或加速幅度。
commentary.en: iq 2.2.0 unifies text, Parquet and data-frame inputs, introduces streaming and parallel batch quantification, switches MaxLFQ routines to the maxlfq_bit solver and removes Rcpp/RcppEigen dependencies. The release notes do not establish independent accuracy or speed improvements.
